title: Dataq Ledger — Overview
meta_description: Shared truth with regulatory teeth — permissioned networks that survive supervision.

blocks.x: Shared truth with regulatory teeth — permissioned networks that survive supervision. Dataq Ledger is the platform layer behind it — deployed under NDA, documented for the audit.

Dataq Ledger is the institution-grade DLT platform: permissioned network engineering (Fabric/Besu-class) with governance charters and legal wrappers, tokenization with securities-law discipline, smart contracts built to formal-verification standards, provenance networks for EUDR/DPP-grade traceability, and verifiable-credential ecosystems against eIDAS 2.0 expectations. Ledger leads with governance because networks fail on governance, not cryptography: membership rules, data-visibility zones, key custody under HSM, and regulator packs — privacy model, audit exports, jurisdiction analysis — shipped with every network.
